hazards.label: Heat

hazards.label: Icing

hazards.label: Lightning
hazards.effect_note: No hazard cell exists; the twin carries Medium surge leads on the electronics (discussion 04 §6).

anatomy_note.sentence: Hazard's reference profile describes each building as 6 systems (foundation and floor, structural frame, roof assembly, walls and openings, fixed services and interiors). In its own words: “Groups explain anatomy; they do not require six separate curves or cost allocations.” Only hail prices parts of a building, so the rows here are what the curves price.

split.sentence: These cells split the building differently: the cells name different numbers of parts: convective wind 4, flood 5, hail 7, hurricane wind 5 and wildfire 4; hail splits each building into the roof and the walls and windows, each a share of the building's value; the other hazards price the building as one; retail has a curve under flood and hurricane wind only; convective wind, hail and wildfire do not name it. Buildings carry no dollar value here: every curve is a share of the building's structure replacement cost, which the consumer supplies.
